listing.name: Gran Turismo 2 (Simulation Mode v1.2) — gt2-recomp (SamiulH25)
listing.summary: Upstream reports menus, the garage and race rendering from a mix of recompiled and progressively decompiled code. Save/load through a full session remains unconfirmed. Portcove has not confirmed runtime behavior or gameplay. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA Gran Turismo 2 Simulation Mode v1.2 disc in CUE/BIN form, MD5 e697a485b661a12fa6c327186c336a31, with SCUS_944.88. Keep your originals separately.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow upstream’s local PSXRecomp generation and CMake build with your own data and OpenBIOS. The project uses an overlay interpreter and GTFS. Portcove does not install or prepare this source project automatically.
